units.source_text: 白110和白108盯着左上角的黑子。

en.t: White 110 and White 108 were aiming at the black stones in the upper left corner.

units.source_text: 七段应以黑109、111两手，角上活净。

en.t: The seventh-dan player should have used Black 109 and 111 to live cleanly in the corner.

units.source_text: 这角上黑子的阵形要是被白攻了进去，要么死要么劫活，这像是珍珑棋局，难就难在这万千的变化上。

en.t: If White managed to invade the shape of Black's stones in this corner, Black would either die or live by ko; it was like an intricate problem game, and the difficulty lay precisely in its countless variations.
